sentences.text: Know the difference between these positions.
A DR uses only the course steered and the speed through the water, ignoring current and wind.
An estimated position improves on the DR with any other information, such as a known current or a single line of position.
With one L O P, the E P is the point on that line nearest your DR position.
A fix uses two or more good lines of position taken at the same time.
In order of reliability: trust a fix over an E P, and an E P over a DR.
